subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved as docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline keys, or should OpenClaw add a public TUI send/newline keybinding config or CLI surface?
rationale: Current main already has default in-editor newline support through pi-tui, but configurability would add a user-facing config/API contract that root policy says needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Document Existing Keys First
options.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md` and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback without adding config surface.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests and docs.

options.title: Defer To Broader Composer Work
options.body: Keep this open or link it to the broader external-editor/vim/composer strategy until maintainers choose one terminal input direction.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Keys First
recommendation.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md` and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback without adding config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent TUI docs/command history and already provided maintainer-facing scope guidance on this issue.
